channel.title: 1bit.MONSTER — Blog
channel.description: How the 1-bit inference engine actually gets built — NPU, ROCm, kernels, formats.

item.title: Lemonade v11.9.0: origin hardening, and upstream took our HRX backend
item.description: The embedded Lemonade server core is re-vendored to v11.9.0 — allowed_origins/CORS hardening, llama.cpp to b10723, the streaming-stall fix, and directory-watcher + extra-model classification fixes. We retired stream_stall_timeout and kept the newer hrx-b66 pin; everything else now matches upstream.

item.title: Zaya 8B Q4NX on the AMD NPU
item.description: The full HRX lane journey: serving Zyphra Zaya 8B, 4-bit Q4NX, entirely on the AMD Strix Halo NPU — 8.4 t/s decode, llama-server over HTTP — with Qwen3-0.6B prefill logits corr 1.00000, byte-identical to the real FastFlowLM runtime, and the Windows-NPU (MCDM) memory model matched on Linux: one heap, one chained API call per layer, SharedBO pages with zero copies.

item.title: Lemonade v11.8.1, and how we stay current with the SDK
item.description: The embedded Lemonade server core is re-vendored to v11.8.1 — upstream sync landed; see the post for what changed. Engine HF coverage: 560 architecture tokens, 1,818 HF arch strings, 317,310/317,310 checkpoints mapped.

item.title: HRX: we put AMD's experimental IREE runtime inside our engine
item.description: AMD's experimental IREE runtime is now an in-process decode lane in our engine: dlopen'd bundle, two llama.cpps, ~2x HIP warm decode on a 30B MoE GGUF.

item.title: Lemonade v11.8.0: the 15-backend SDK lands ds4 for Strix Halo
item.description: Lemonade v11.8.0 re-vendored: the 15th backend (ds4/DwarfStar, DeepSeek V4 Flash for Strix Halo), download resume, rate limits, and our merged PR.

item.title: One engine, every model
item.description: One C++ binary, 560 architecture tokens, 1,818 HF arch strings, 100% HuggingFace coverage, 317,310 checkpoints mapped. Every model you can download.

item.title: Local RAG with our own embeddings
item.description: The engine now serves embeddings over its OpenAI-compatible API. Build fully local RAG on one C++ binary: embed, index, retrieve, generate.

item.title: What 1-bit actually does to a model
item.description: 1.58-bit (ternary) quantization explained: weights become {-1, 0, +1}, memory drops ~16x, matmuls become additions. Measured, not projected.

item.title: ROCm vs CUDA, from the 1-bit trenches
item.description: ROCm vs CUDA for local LLM inference: kernel-level comparison from the 1bit.MONSTER engine — 1-bit matmuls, NPU offload, and why we bet on AMD's stack.

item.title: Lemonade v11.7.0, and how we stay current with the SDK
item.description: The embedded Lemonade server core re-vendored to v11.7.0: 14 backends incl. TheNoise, register/options/stats/metrics endpoints live, re-vendor loop documented.

item.title: Two PCs, two GPUs, zero cloud
item.description: Two DeepSeek Harness agents on one LAN, both fed by 1bit.MONSTER: 35B at 166 tok/s on Radeon 8060S, 8B at 96 tok/s on RX 9070 XT, plus Qwen3-VL.

item.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B streams fully on the Ryzen AI NPU
item.description: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on the Ryzen AI NPU: FLM's 13.65 tok/s decode and 221.96 tok/s prefill decoded, verified, plus our 75.65 tok/s Vulkan first pass.

item.title: 37 FLM models, 209 xclbins, zero config files
item.description: AMD's NPU model zoo extracted from ROCm/FastFlowLM v0.9.46: 37 FLM models, 209 xclbin bitstreams, zero config — auto-detected from the Q4NX header.

item.title: Zyphra family complete
item.description: All four Zyphra models at 1BP, validated end to end on ZINC GPU: Zamba2 1.2B/2.7B/7B (Mamba2-hybrid) and ZR1-1.5B reasoning at 26 tok/s on Strix Halo.

item.title: One binary, all formats
item.description: Ternary and binary inference on NPU and GPU from one engine: Q1_0, TQ1, TQ2, IQ1_S/M and BitNet GGUF on HIP, Vulkan and XDNA 2 — verified on Strix Halo.

item.title: Unsloth for AMD
item.description: Training, fine-tuning and RL land on Radeon, Instinct and Ryzen AI: 2x faster, 70% less VRAM, runs in 3GB. Stated plainly, complementary to inference.

item.title: TokenRouter: token-level multi-backend inference
item.description: Open-source token-level routing for multi-backend LLM inference on AMD Strix Halo. NPU drafts, GPU verifies, and real logprobs ride on the wire.

item.title: What the Ryzen AI Halo reviews didn't tell you
item.description: Strix Halo's 50 TOPS NPU: FLM delivers 11 tok/s, ROCm 41 tok/s, and we drive the same NPU through a fused-layer engine. A review of the reviews.

item.title: DSpark speculative decoding, disproven
item.description: DSpark promised 572 tok/s on Strix Halo; measurement found 0.1-0.2 tok/s at 0% draft acceptance. How it failed, why, and what it would take to fix.

item.title: Three bugs that broke 97 tok/s
item.description: 97 tok/s was real; the output never was. Three silent bugs — LM head substitution, weight transpose, activation clipping — produced garbage at full speed.

item.title: One engine. Every model. Any chip.
item.description: A single tiny C++ binary auto-detects 73+ models across six backends, from NPU to CPU, from one Q4NX header parse. No per-backend builds, no per-model config.

item.title: 244 to 3.4 ms/tok: the NPU optimization sprint
item.description: Seven engine versions in four days took NPU inference from 1,930 to 3.4 ms/tok — a 72x speedup via batch decode, fused dispatch, and INT8 GEMM.

item.title: 50 TOPS on a laptop
item.description: Benchmarking the XDNA 2 NPU: historical NPU benchmark notes from the first month of the project. Figures quarantined as unsourced.

item.title: The fused layer engine
item.description: How QKV, attention and FFN combine into a single NPU dispatch, cutting per-layer xclbin calls 6x. Historical throughput figures noted as unsourced.

item.title: I reverse-engineered AMD's NPU stack in 4 days
item.description: A laptop, a disassembler, no docs: AMD's 50 TOPS XDNA 2 NPU locked behind 22 proprietary libraries, replaced with open C++ in four days.

item.title: 1bit Coding Agent released
item.description: A pi.dev-compatible coding agent CLI: 7 commands, NPU-native inference, package management, extensions, skills, themes, systemd — in the monorepo.

item.title: NPU v12: M=32 batch decode at 97 tok/s
item.description: A 24x speedup in one session, from 244 to 10 ms/tok, beating FLM Kraken Point by 46%. OpenMP attention plus LM head. Full C++23, zero Python.

item.title: Historical benchmark: both lanes green
item.description: An early local run with one Lemonade endpoint over two compute lanes, iGPU llama.cpp ROCm plus NPU FLM, on Linux. Historical local run, kept for the record.
